'''Masi Qual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who held the [[Military rank/Legends|Rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Considered smug and self-righteous, Qual grew up on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in a wealthy family. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] rose to power, and alien discrimination became the norm, Qual's family had to flee from Coruscant. [[Masi Qual's father|Her father]] often ranted about the Empire, and how their family lost a lot of prestige when they had to leave Coruscant. This made Qual hold a great deal of resentment toward the Empire, and so she joined the Rebellion. She was suspected of conspiring against the Alliance after a traitor was confirmed within its ranks.<ref name="OAA1" />
